doc_name: Figure skating at the 2010 Winter Olympics – Ice dance
text: The ice dance competition at the 2010 Winter Olympics took place at the Pacific Coliseum in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, on February 19 (compulsory dance), February 21 (original dance), and February 22 (free dance), 2010. The compulsory dance on February 19 featured the Tango Romantica. The original dance was performed on February 21, and the free dance occurred on February 22, 2010. Tessa Virtue and Scott Moir became the first ice dancers from Canada and North America to win an Olympic gold medal. They were the first former World Junior Ice dance champions to achieve Olympic gold, the first ice dance team to win Olympic gold on home ice, and the first ice dancers to win gold on their Olympic debut since the inaugural Olympic ice dance event in 1976. They were also the youngest ice dance Olympic champions at 20 and 22 years of age. Isabelle Delobel competed at the Olympics with partner Olivier Schoenfelder just four-and-a-half months after giving birth. The event included roles for a Referee, Technical Controller, Technical Specialist, Assistant Technical Specialist, Judges (CD), Judges (OD), and Judges (FD).
